api_key.hint: If empty, read OPENAI_API_KEY from the environment, then the plugin's OPENAI_API_KEY or .local/OPENAI_API_KEY file.

base_url.hint: Include /v1, not /images/generations. Reference images require JSON support for /images/edits.

timeout_seconds.hint: Set AstrBot's tool timeout higher, allowing time for reference loading and delivery. Failed requests are not automatically retried.

max_saved_requests.description: Maximum number of saved image generation requests
max_saved_requests.hint: A positive integer. Images from each request are saved in the same numbered directory. After successfully saving request N, directories numbered less than or equal to N minus this limit are deleted.
